checks.name: Frontend implementation surface
checks.recommendation: Increase implemented pages and shared components coverage for user-facing flows that are still thin or undocumented.

checks.name: Backend implementation surface
checks.recommendation: Ensure backend modules, routes, and service handlers cover all expected feature areas with traceable API surfaces.

checks.name: Cross-platform and shared-contract coverage
checks.recommendation: Keep shared contracts, schema definitions, and cross-platform feature surfaces synchronized across client, server, and mobile targets.

checks.name: Implementation detail density
checks.recommendation: Thin modules should be reviewed to confirm they contain complete implementation logic rather than placeholders or wiring-only code.

checks.name: Typed code ratio
checks.recommendation: Increase strongly typed implementation coverage where JavaScript or shell-heavy modules dominate critical logic.

checks.name: Test density
checks.recommendation: Add automated test coverage around critical routes, services, integrations, and production-risk workflows.

checks.name: Unresolved placeholder hygiene
checks.recommendation: Resolve TODO, FIXME, XXX, and HACK markers in production paths or explicitly track them outside runtime code.

checks.name: Production mock smell
checks.recommendation: Remove or isolate mock, fake, and stub logic from production paths unless clearly feature-flagged or documented as test support.

checks.name: Service directory breadth
checks.recommendation: Confirm each bounded service area has operational documentation, ownership, and integration validation.

checks.name: Integration diversity
checks.recommendation: Document, test, and validate each detected external integration domain with ownership, retry policy, and failure handling.

checks.name: Environment-driven integrations
checks.recommendation: Move integration configuration fully into environment or secret-management flows and avoid implicit local defaults for production-critical services.

checks.name: Asynchronous and event-driven architecture signals
checks.recommendation: Validate retries, DLQs, idempotency, and alerting for asynchronous jobs, consumers, and event-driven services.

checks.name: Authentication and authorization foundations
checks.recommendation: Review authentication, authorization, and identity boundaries to ensure each detected auth-related surface is covered by policy and tests.

checks.name: Security middleware and control signals
checks.recommendation: Ensure CSRF, CORS, rate limiting, secure headers, secret handling, and password protections are consistently enforced across services.

checks.name: Hardcoded secret hygiene
checks.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials or tokens and replace them with environment-backed or secret-managed configuration.

checks.name: Security scanning in delivery pipeline
checks.recommendation: Keep dependency, filesystem, and container scanning wired into the CI gate rather than relying on ad hoc manual checks.

checks.name: Containerization assets
checks.recommendation: Standardize and validate container build definitions, runtime configuration, and local environment parity.

checks.name: Orchestration and deployment manifests
checks.recommendation: Ensure each deployment manifest is environment-aware, validated, and mapped to a tested release process.

checks.name: Observability and monitoring assets
checks.recommendation: Expand metrics, alert rules, dashboards, and log routing to cover all mission-critical services and integrations.

checks.name: Resilience and operational health signals
checks.recommendation: Link health endpoints, rollback paths, chaos assets, and monitoring to a documented production recovery posture.

checks.name: Core CI stages
checks.recommendation: Keep lint, test, build, and security stages mandatory for pull requests and release branches.

checks.name: Deployment gating stages
checks.recommendation: Require promotion through explicit staging and production gates with smoke tests and rollback handling.

checks.name: Artifact and performance controls
checks.recommendation: Retain build artifacts and performance budgets as first-class deployment gates rather than optional post-merge checks.

checks.name: Local pipeline parity
checks.recommendation: Preserve local verification entry points so developers can reproduce CI failures before opening deployment-bound changes.

checks.name: Documentation presence
checks.recommendation: Add or update architecture, onboarding, operations, and feature documents so implementation depth is matched by maintainable guidance.

checks.name: Environment and configuration examples
checks.recommendation: Keep sanitized environment examples current for every deployable service and integration domain.

checks.name: Operational script coverage
checks.recommendation: Consolidate production runbooks with the scripts actually used for setup, migration, remediation, and deployment.

checks.name: Repository inventory coverage
checks.recommendation: Preserve full-repository scanning so feature-completeness and readiness scoring stay evidence-based as the codebase evolves.
